skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Use context to infer word meanings
Develop advanced vocabulary through topics covered in class and additional reading materials
Expand vocabulary with compound words, affixes, synonyms, antonyms, polysemous words, collocations, idiomatic expressions, and irony
Read for main ideas and specific details
Use visual aids, titles, transitions, and prior knowledge to support comprehension
Read annotated texts, ask questions while reading, use charts to find information, and take notes using models
Read critically, identify two-sided arguments, distinguish between facts and opinions
Summarize, compare, outline, paraphrase main ideas, and present arguments
Identify essay structure and how supporting details develop the main idea
Understand and describe various types of charts, graphs, tables, and process diagrams
Write paragraphs including introduction, body, and conclusion
Write argumentative essays on cause-effect, comparison-contrast, problem-solution, and personal opinion
Recognize and understand the format of IELTS reading and writing exam questions
Apply reading and writing skills at levels B2 to C1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference, equivalent to IELTS 6.0-6.5
Participate actively in group activities to solve problems
Have the ability to learn independently, research materials to complete assignments and tasks
Prepare academic skills for international English proficiency exams and help consolidate specialized subjects in subsequent semesters
